Before activating
This shortcut creates two continuous blocks with one confirmation:
Pornography: blocked with no end date. The category includes known adult sites and related addresses.
Social networks: apps and sites such as YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, X, Reddit and others are blocked 24 hours a day for 180 days (six 30-day months).
Messengers: WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, Messenger, Discord and other dedicated messaging apps are excluded from this shortcut.
Pornography protection does not expire on its own. The social-network block ends automatically after 180 days.
To confirm, type the Portuguese phrase below exactly. Paste, autofill, or multi-character insertion will be rejected.
